conviction_note: The +76% five-session run-in rests on a US$10m buyback authorisation that is the sixth consecutive annual US$10m authorisation and a straight rollover of the one that expired 2026-09-04, and the growth story it is being valued on drew 62% of Q1 revenue out of a depleting pre-sale balance while cash fell 2.8x the reported loss; sized at roughly one daily sigma (realised vol ~7%/day) rather than the sum of parts, because the Q2 YoY headline against a RMB25.4m base is guaranteed to look spectacular and last year's same-quarter print rose 19%.

findings.finding: The US$10m buyback that drove the stock +21.5% on 2026-09-03 and anchored the +76% five-session run is 17 Education's sixth consecutive annual US$10m authorisation (Nov 2021, Sep 2022, Sep 2023, Sep 2024, Sep 2025, Sep 2026) and is a straight rollover of the identical US$10m program that ran 2025-09-04 to 2026-09-04 and expired four days before this one started.
findings.why_not_priced: The 2026-09-03 release makes no reference to any prior program, and the identical predecessor was buried inside the 2025-09-04 Q2 earnings 6-K rather than issued as its own headline. Volume on 2026-09-03 was 2,789,500 ADS against a 20-day median of 4,600 before the event - a ~600x spike in a 10.86m-ADS name with no sell-side coverage and no option chain. If the market had recognised this as an expiring-program rollover rather than new capital, the tape would show a low-volume drift, not a 600x-volume +21.5% day followed by three more up sessions on no news at all; and the stock would not still be adding +18% intraday on 2026-09-08 on roughly average volume with nothing in the wire since 2026-09-03.
findings.independence: Independent primary confirmation of the recurrence pattern from four separate filings, none of which is the 2026 release: the 2023-09-21 6-K authorising US$10m from 2023-11-02 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1821468/000095017023049313/yq-6k-09-22-2023.htm), the 2022-09-29 6-K authorising US$10m from 2022-11-02 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1821468/000119312522254314/d300245d6k.htm), the 2021-11-02 announcement of US$10m (https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2021/11/02/2325327/0/en/17-Education-Technology-Group-Inc-Announces-US-10-Million-Share-Repurchase-Program-and-Plan-to-Implement-ADS-Ratio-Change.html), and the 2025-09-04 Q2 2025 release carrying the immediately-preceding US$10m authorisation (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1821468/000095017025112952/yq-ex99_1.htm). The FY2025 20-F's XBRL tagging separately names ShareRepurchaseProgramInSeptemberTwoThousandAndTwentyFourMember and ...TwentyFiveMember (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001821468/000119312526191472/yq-20251231.htm).

findings.finding: Q1 2026's headline RMB99.5m revenue (+359% YoY) was drawn largely out of a one-off pre-sale balance rather than new demand: deferred revenue and advances from customers fell from RMB165.9m at 2025-12-31 to RMB104.5m at 2026-03-31, a RMB61.5m drawdown equal to 62% of the quarter's revenue, and cash plus term deposits fell RMB54.6m (RMB406.9m to RMB352.3m) against a reported net loss of only RMB19.4m - 2.8x the loss.
findings.why_not_priced: There is no sell-side model on a US$37.4m-market-cap name, no consensus estimate published, and every piece of wire copy on the quarter carried only the two lines the company led with - '+359.0% year-over-year' and 'Yiqi Aixue revenue more than quadrupled'. The Q1 earnings call had no Q&A at all (the operator recorded no questions), so the drawdown was never put to management. Had the market modelled the unwind, a stock at 0.73x its own liquid assets would not need a recurring buyback authorisation to re-rate 76%; the re-rating is being justified by the growth narrative, which is precisely the thing the deferred-revenue line qualifies. The remaining RMB104.5m balance also caps how much of this can repeat.
findings.independence: The year-ago control comes from a DIFFERENT filing and shows the drawdown is not seasonal: in Q1 2025 deferred revenue fell only RMB40.4m to RMB36.9m, i.e. RMB3.5m or 16% of that quarter's RMB21.7m revenue, versus 62% this year, and cash plus deposits fell RMB25.9m against a LARGER net loss of RMB30.9m - https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1821468/000095017025084635/yq-ex99_1.htm (2025-06-11). The Q4/FY2025 release shows where the balance came from - RMB40.4m at 2024-12-31 and RMB36.5m at 2025-09-30 building to RMB165.9m at 2025-12-31 on pre-sales of the new consumer product: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1821468/000119312526122709/yq-ex99_1.htm (2026-03-25) and https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1821468/000119312525313418/yq-ex99_1.htm (2025-12-10). NOTE: the RMB61.5m deferred-revenue drawdown and the RMB54.6m cash decline are two readings of the same Q1 2026 document and are filed here as one finding, not two.

findings.finding: The company dismissed Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu as its auditor effective 2026-05-27 and appointed Marcum Asia CPAs LLP for the year ending 2026-12-31 - i.e. it dropped a Big Four auditor two quarters after its revenue recognition profile changed beyond recognition, and the Q2 2026 numbers about to be released are the first reported under the new firm.
findings.why_not_priced: It was disclosed in a 6-K with no press release and no GlobeNewswire distribution - it does not appear in the company's news feed alongside the buyback, the earnings date or the Q1 results, and the stock's reaction that day was -4.0%. It is a dismissal initiated by the company, not a resignation, with no disagreements or reportable events cited, so there is no headline to attach it to. If the market had weighted it, a name that just re-rated 76% on a boilerplate buyback would not be paying up for the same audited growth story; the coverage would carry a governance qualifier and it carries none.
findings.independence: Points the same way as, but is documented separately from, the revenue-quality finding above (different filing, different date, different subject matter). No third-party source independently flags it - no analyst, ratings agency or short report on this name was found.

searched_and_found_nothing: Buyback fundability/capacity: the 'is the US$10m actually payable offshore' angle is dead. The FY2025 20-F condensing schedule shows Cayman-plus-other-subsidiary cash of RMB34.5m and term deposits of RMB160.5m - roughly US$27m of offshore liquidity against a US$10m authorisation, so capacity is not the constraint. The constraint is willingness, which is what finding 1 is about.

Insider-buying cluster: the 13 Form 4s between 2026-07-06 and 2026-09-04 look like a CEO accumulating into the print, but today's 13D/A (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1821468/000119312526384376/xslSCHEDULE_13D_X02/primary_doc.xml, 2026-09-08) discloses them as 110,628 ADS for ~US$0.24m total bought 2026-06-30 to 2026-09-03 under a Rule 10b5-1 plan running to 2028-03-31. Automated, pre-committed, ~US$24k a clip, and therefore carries zero information about the quarter. This is a lead that dies on inspection.

Going-private / take-private setup: Andy Chang Liu holds 41.30% of shares and 95.0% of votes and the company trades below net cash, but the 13D/A of 2026-09-08 states the purchases are 'for investment purposes' with no mention of a merger, tender offer or going-private proposal.

Nasdaq listing deficiency: no minimum bid price, market-value-of-publicly-held-shares or ADS-ratio notice found in the FY2025 20-F or anywhere in the 2026 filing stream. Last ADS ratio change was 2021 (to 1 ADS : 10 Class A, now 1:50); nothing pending.

Any news at all in the window that would justify the 2026-09-04 to 2026-09-08 second leg (+18% intraday on 2026-09-08 on roughly average volume): the company news feed is empty between 2026-09-03 and the print. Checked stocktitan, GlobeNewswire, Yahoo press releases, EDGAR.

Consumer footprint for Yiqi Aixue, the product carrying the entire growth story: no App Store or Google Play listing findable under that exact name, no appearance in any of the 2026 618 or summer Chinese learning-device buying guides (which list 作业帮, 小猿, 学而思, 科大讯飞, 步步高), and no ranking or download data on Qimai reachable. Treated as unsourced absence and NOT filed as a finding - Chinese app and e-commerce data are poorly indexed from here and an absence in US search is not evidence.

Paying-user, subscription or hardware-unit metrics: the company has never disclosed one. Not in the Q1 2026 release, not in the Q1 call (which had no Q&A), not in the Chinese-language Q1 PR. So there is no user metric to trend into this print.

Q2 2026 guidance: none exists. The only forward statement on the Q1 call was qualitative - 'strong year-over-year revenue growth and continued improvement in operating performance throughout 2026' with an explicit warning that 'quarterly results may vary'. There is no number for the print to beat or miss.
Government/school tender awards for the To-G and To-B smart-education lines: not retrievable from here; Chinese public procurement portals were not reachable through the available tooling.
baseline_tension: There is no skew and no implied move to agree or disagree with - the chain is empty and the baseline's 4.29% expected move and 2-of-8 up-count are, as flagged, artefacts of a 6-K text matcher rather than an earnings base rate - so the only real thing the baseline states is the run-up, and my findings cut squarely against it: the +42.5% 20-day and +74% 5-day moves are the market paying for a buyback rollover and a growth line that came 62% out of a depleting pre-sale balance, which is why I am negative on a name still trading at 0.73x its own liquid assets; the honest caveat is that with no options I have materially less information about what is priced than a hunter on a listed-option name, and the upside tail is real because the Q2 YoY headline against a RMB25.4m base cannot help but look spectacular and the same quarter last year printed +19%.
